sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:79

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:79:1
items.html:
By the Tree of Knowledge, which is the world of Assiya, he was commanded not to eat from it, since he had no part in Assiya: That is the world of Assiya of now, which was then the place of the shells alone, for the end of Assiya was then at the place of the Chazeh of Yetzira, as above. And the reason for this is that then, by ZON, nothing was sorted out but the aspects of the 288 of the sparks and vessels that fell to BYA — which are the 288 sparks — and this includes only Yetzira and Beria from the time of the kings; but of the aspects of the last 32 sparks, which are the aspects of the Malchut within them, called the thirty-two of the stone, nothing of them was sorted out as yet. And therefore the Assiya of then ended at the place of the Chazeh of Yetzira of now, which is also the place of the Chazeh of the Yetzira that was at the time of the kings; and from there and below it was all the aspects of the shells, for nothing of them was sorted out to the holiness.
And this is what he says: “By the Tree of Knowledge, which is the world of Assiya, he was commanded not to eat from it, since he had no part in Assiya” — that is, as explained, that nothing of the aspect of Assiya was sorted out in the MAN of the soul of Adam HaRishon, but only from Yetzira and Beria alone. And therefore there is nothing of the aspect of Assiya in his soul. And since the aspects of the thirty-two of the stone, which are the 32 last sparks of the 320 sparks that fell in the breaking of the vessels to BYA, are no longer standing for sorting by themselves — for all the sortings are only in the secret of the 288 sparks alone, namely, from the first 288 of them — therefore Adam HaRishon was forbidden to eat from the Tree of Knowledge, which is the secret of Assiya, for eating is a matter of sortings, as is known.
And the reason that only the world of Assiya is the aspect of the Tree of Knowledge, and not Assiya and above, is that the Daat is not revealed except after the cessation of the Yesod of Ima, namely, from the Chazeh and downward, as the ARI wrote above, Item 77: “the body of man is divided into two parts: down to the Chazeh the Yesod of Bina expands and the lights within it are covered, and from the Chazeh downward the lights are revealed.” See there. And therefore the illumination of the Daat, which is the covered HG that are from the Chazeh and upward, is called by the name the Tree of Life, after Ima, who is called “the life of the king,” for there the posterior of Ima rule, as above. And the illumination of the Daat from the Chazeh and downward, which is the HG revealed in the illumination of Hochma, is called by the name the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil, for there is the rule of the shells, which are called evil, and the sparks of holiness within them are called good; and the Creator forbade him to sort out the good from the evil, as written above — that there are no sortings but only in the 288 sparks, and the 32 last ones are corrected completely through them; but in the 32 last ones no sorting applies, for the Creator gave them to the place of the rule of the shells.
Therefore only the world of Assiya alone is the aspect of the Tree of Knowledge, for it was explained above that the aspect of the Chazeh and below of the level of the soul is the ten Sefirot of Assiya. And therefore, relative to the whole of the Partzuf of the seven lower ones of Nekudim that fell to BYA, the Malchut of Yetzira, which is the place of the Chazeh of that Partzuf, is found, and all the ten Sefirot of the world of Assiya are the aspect of the Chazeh and below of that Partzuf. And therefore there is the place of the Tree of Knowledge, and there is the place of the shells — which are the aspects of the thirty-two of the stone, which were not given to sorting, except in the secret of “And I will remove the thirty-two of the stone from your midst,” etc., for through the sortings of the 288 sparks they too are corrected, as above; and as further written in its place. (And see in the Gate of Verses, Section 2, the passage beginning “And from the Tree of Knowledge.”)
And now the difference is well explained between the Partzuf of the soul of Adam HaRishon and the general Partzuf of the seven lower ones of Nekudim that fell to BYA: for the soul of Adam HaRishon had no part whatsoever of the world of Assiya of the Partzuf of the seven lower ones of Nekudim, and it ended, in their measure, even above the four lower ones of Yetzira, as explained. For this part, from the Chazeh and below of the Partzuf of Nekudim, is the aspect of the Tree of Knowledge, whose dross was not sorted out at all; and therefore this place remained in the aspect of the shells.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:79:2
items.html:
Caused a flaw in all the worlds, etc., Yetzira became clothed in Assiya, etc.: For by his eating of the Tree of Knowledge — meaning that he wanted to sort out the good and the sparks of holiness from there, as above — not only did he not sort out anything from there, but he further caused by this that all those sortings that had already been sorted out by ZON, from the MAN of the Vav and the point, returned and fell from all the degrees of Atzilut. In such a way that the ten Sefirot of Yetzira fell to the aspect of Assiya, where is the place of the shells, and mingled there with them, until the holiness is not discernible there. And Beria fell to the aspect of Yetzira, and the nine lower ones of the Nukva of Atzilut descended to Beria; and likewise all the Mochin of the upper Partzufim, which had risen by the MAN of the Vav and the point, returned and were nullified and descended from them, and they remained only with the Mochin that came out in them on the MAN of the two upper aspects — back to back and face to back — which were in Nekudim, in which no ascent and descent applies, for their coupling never ceases forever. (As above, page 671, the passage beginning “And Already.”)
And in truth, the soul of Adam HaRishon and the Partzufim of Atzilut had yet greater ascents, as the ARI wrote before us. However, considering the state that all the Partzufim attained at the time of the birth of the soul of Adam HaRishon, it is found that the sin of Adam HaRishon caused each and every one to descend only one degree from what it was — namely, that it returned and lost that degree which it had attained by virtue of the coupling that came out on the MAN of the Vav and the point.
In such a way that the AA of then, which had already attained the degree of Atik, descended to the AVI of then, which is in truth its place, which it had before the ascent of the MAN of the Vav and the point. And so on for all of them: for the AVI of then descended to the place of ZON of then, in that Aba descended to the place of ZA, and Ima descended to the place of the Nukva. And ZON returned back to back as before, being regarded that the ZA of then descended to the place of the Nukva, and the nine lower ones of the Nukva descended to the Beria of now. And Beria, which was then in the place of ZON, descended to the Beria of now; and Yetzira, which was then in the place of Beria, descended to the place of Yetzira of now; and Assiya, which was then in the place of Yetzira of now, fell to the place of Assiya of now. Hence each one fell only one degree. And this is what he says: “And all of them descended from their degree in this manner, for Yetzira became clothed in Assiya, etc.” — for the lower one that rises into the place of the upper one becomes exactly like it, as is known. And therefore the Assiya of then, which was in the place of Yetzira of now, was made into Yetzira itself. And it is now found that after the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, when it returned and fell to Assiya, Yetzira is found clothed in Assiya. And so on for all of them. And understand this well.
